0022600088.text: The Toronto Raptors host the Chicago Bulls in a regular-season game, with both teams opening their 2026-27 seasons. The Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 139-109 win in Chicago on March 18, 2026. Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Nate Bittle, who is out with a foot injury, while Chicago is without Jordan Hawkins (illness) and Nic Claxton (hamstring), both listed as out. Chicago also has Dailyn Swain (illness) listed as day-to-day, and Isaac Okoro (knee), Leonard Miller (groin), Tobe Awaka (knee) and Zach Collins (toe, after surgery) are day-to-day and game-time decisions.
